title: Global Prime Lateral File Cabinet — 2 to 6 Drawer
body_html:
Welded-steel lateral filing engineered to lock down records and stand up to decades of institutional use.

Global's Prime lateral file cabinet is built from fully welded, reinforced steel and scales from a compact 2-drawer unit to a six-high tower in 30", 36" and 42" widths. An interlock system lets only one drawer open at a time to prevent tipping, while full-extension ball-bearing slides and side-to-side hanging bars handle letter, legal or A4 files with ease. Made in Canada and finished in any of 30 painted colours or 24 coordinating laminates, it pairs cam locks with removable cores for the secure document storage institutional offices depend on.

Key features

  • Available in 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 drawer heights with fixed or recessed fronts
  • Interlock system allows only one drawer open at a time to prevent tipping
  • Anti-bounce-back drawer suspension keeps drawers from sliding open
  • Full-extension ball-bearing slides with side-to-side hanging file bars for letter, legal or A4
  • Integrated full pulls on every drawer; cam locks with removable cores and optional individual drawer locking
  • Leveling glides with 1" adjustment accessible from inside the cabinet

Who it’s for

Records-heavy private offices, administrative areas and open-plan workstations in school boards, hospitals and municipal departments that need secure, high-capacity filing.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
